Guardians.name: Guardians
Guardians.description:
Guardians

Those humans who serve the Heavenly Choir are called guardians.

  • ADAPTABLE: Guardians begin play with any Novice Edge of their choosing (meeting its Requirements as usual). (grants to special abilities)
  • @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-edges.Champion]{CHAMPIONS}: Guardians have the Champion Edge, giving them a +2 bonus to damage against supernaturally evil foes such as demons and devils. (grants to edges)
  • VIGOROUS: Those humans who have inherited this blasted Earth start the game with a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Vigor} instead of a d4. This increases their Vigor maximum to d12+1. (via active effects)
  • @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-hindrances.Vow]{VOW} (Major — Protect humanity): The blessed must protect the flock that remains on the ravaged Earth. (grants to hindrances)

Vigorous.name: Vigorous
Vigorous.description: Those humans who have inherited this blasted Earth start the game with a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Vigor} instead of a d4. This increases their Vigor maximum to d12+1

Rakashans.name: Rakashans
Rakashans.description:
Rakashans

Rakashans are humanoid felines. Some have the bright colors of tigers, the speckled hides of leopards, or the exotic look of Siamese cats. All have sharp claws and teeth, and a cruel nature when it comes to dealing with their prey.

Rakashans can be found in their own remote and exotic cities or as fringe elements of normal society. They are often too clever and beautiful to be shunned, but too cunning to gain others’ complete trust.

  • AGILE: Feline grace gives rakashans a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Agility} attribute instead of a d4. This increases maximum Agility to d12+1. (via active effects)
  • BITE/CLAWS: Rakashan fangs and claws are @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03naturalweapo00]{Natural Weapons} that cause Strength+d4 damage. (grants to weapons)
  • BLOODTHIRSTY: Rakashans can be cruel to their foes, often toying with them for simple amusement. They rarely take prisoners and feel little compunction about punishing captured foes. (grants to hindrances)
  • CAN'T SWIM: Rakashans actually can swim, they just shun it and are not particularly good at it. They subtract 2 from @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Athletics]{Athletics} (swimming) rolls and each tabletop inch of movement in water uses 3″ of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace}. (grants to hindrances)
  • LOW LIGHT VISION: Rakashan eyes amplify light. They ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}. (grants to special abilities)
  • ANCESTRAL ENEMY: Rakashan society rose at the expense of another. Pick a common ancestry in your setting. Members of each culture subtract 2 from @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Persuasion]{Persuasion} when dealing with each other and often attack on sight. (grants to special abilities)

Agile.name: Agile
Agile.description: Feline grace gives rakashans a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Agility} attribute instead of a d4. This increases maximum Agility to d12+1

Aquarian.name: Aquarian
Aquarian.description:
Aquarian

From the crushing ocean depths come aquatic folk. They are thick and sturdy beneath the waves but often vulnerable in the dry air or searing heat of the surface.

  • AQUATIC: Aquarians cannot drown in water and move at their full Pace when swimming. See @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Movement} for normal swimming rates. (grants to special abilities)
  • DEPENDENCY: Aquarians must immerse them­selves in water one hour out of every 24 or become automatically Fatigued each day until they are @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Incapacitated}. The day after Incapacitation from dehydration, they perish. Each hour spent in water restores one level of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03fatigue0000000]{Fatigue}. (grants to special abilities)
  • LOW LIGHT VISION: Aquarians are used to the darkness of the depths. They ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}. (grants to special abilities)
  • TOUGHNESS: Life in the depths of their watery worlds has made aquarian flesh tough and resilient. Add +1 to their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Toughness}. (grants to special abilities)

Avion.name: Avion
Avion.description:
Avion

Avions are humanoids with wings. They tend to be very slight of build owing to their hollow bones. Some are feathered while others are leathery or even scaled.

  • CAN'T SWIM: Avions’ wings are a hazard in water. They subtract 2 from @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Athletics]{Athletics} (swimming) rolls and each inch moved in water costs them 3″ of Pace. (grants to special abilities)
  • FLIGHT: Avions fly at @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} 12 per round. Use @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Athletics]{Athletics} when maneuvering. (grants to special abilities) (grants to hindrances)
  • FRAIL: Avions have −1 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Toughness} due to their hollow bones. (grants to special abilities)
  • KEEN SENSES: Avions are more perceptive than most. They begin with a d6 in @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Notice]{Notice} (instead of d4) and may raise the skill to d12+1. (via active effect)
  • REDUCED PACE: Dependence on flight and bulky wings make avions slightly slower when walking. Decrease their walking @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} by 1 and their running die by one step. (grants to special abilities)

Keen Senses.name: Keen Senses
Keen Senses.description: Avions are more perceptive than most. They begin with a d6 in @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Notice]{Notice} (instead of d4) and may raise the skill to d12+1

Half-Elves.name: Half-Elves
Half-Elves.description:
Half-elves

Half-elves gain the elves’ grace but none of their elegant frailty. Most are well-adjusted, but some are shunned by one side of the family or the other and grow resentful. Others may even be mistreated. Their lifespans are closer to their human parent than those of their elven kin, living only to about 100 years.

  • HERITAGE: Half-elves may retain the grace of their elven parent or the adaptability of their human ancestry. A half-elf may either start with a free Novice @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01edges000000000]{Edge} of his choice or a d6 in @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Agility} instead of a d4 (which also increases his Agility maximum to d12+1). (grants to special abilities or active effects based on choiceSet)
  • LOW LIGHT VISION: Half-elves ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}. (grants to special abilities)
  • OUTSIDER (Minor): Half-elves are never quite comfortable in human or elven society, having a foot in both worlds but never fully standing in either. They subtract 2 from @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Persuasion]{Persuasion} rolls with all but others of their kind. (grants to Hindrances)

Elves.name: Elves
Elves.description:
Elves

Elves are tall, thin souls with pointed ears and deep-set eyes of various colors. Whether they hail from the deep forests or hidden valleys, they are all born more graceful than humans, though somewhat slighter. Most elves live upwards of 300 years. They have fair skin and their hair includes all human colors, plus shades of silver, blue, and gold.

  • AGILE: Elves are graceful and agile. They start with a d6 in @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Agility} instead of a d4. This increases maximum Agility to d12+1. (via active effect)
  • ALL THUMBS: Elves have an inherent dislike of mechanical objects, and thus have the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-hindrances.All Thumbs]{All Thumbs} Hindrance. They shun most mechanical items and designs. (grants to hindrance)
  • LOW LIGHT VISION: Elven eyes amplify light. Others often claim they can see stars in the elves’ eyes. They ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}. (grants to special abilities)

Agile.name: Agile
Agile.description: Elves are graceful and agile. They start with a d6 in @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Agility} instead of a d4. This increases maximum Agility to d12+1

Half-Folk.name: Half-Folk
Half-Folk.description:
Half-Folk

Half-folk are small, nimble people with fuzzy brown or black hair. Though they are frail compared to most other species, their cheerful optimism (or wily cunning) gives them a “never say die” attitude that makes them more than a match for creatures twice their size. Half-folk see no reason to invite trouble and tend to live in their own close-knit communities far off the beaten path.

  • LUCK: Half-folk draw one additional @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03bennies0000000]{Benny} per game session. (grants to special abilities)
  • REDUCED PACE: Decrease the character’s @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} by 1 and their running die one die type. (via active effects)
  • SIZE -1: Half-folk average only about four feet tall, reducing their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03sizeandscale00]{Size} (and therefore @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01characters0000]{Toughness}) by 1. (grants to special abilities)
  • SPIRITED: Half-folk are generally optimistic beings. They start with a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Spirit} instead of a d4. This increases their maximum Spirit to d12+1. (via active effects)

Spirited.name: Spirited
Spirited.description: Half-folk are generally optimistic beings. They start with a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Spirit} instead of a d4. This increases their maximum Spirit to d12+1

Reduced Pace.name: Reduced Pace
Reduced Pace.description: Decrease the character’s @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} by 1 and their running die one die type

Celestials.name: Celestials
Celestials.description:
Celestials

Angels are a great and varied lot, but all have these traits in common.

  • @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-hindrances.All Thumbs]{ALL THUMBS}: Celestials are not accustomed to technology or machines. (grants to hindrances)
  • @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor05powers.JournalEntryPage.05arcanebackgr03]{ARCANE BACKGROUND (Miracles)}: Celestials can call forth a variety of blessed miracles. (grants to edges)
  • @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Faith]{FAITH}: All celestials start with a d6 in Faith. This increases their maximum to d12+1. (grants to skills)
  • FLIGHT: Angels fly at @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} 12. (grants to special abilities)
  • ANCESTRAL ENEMY (Demons & Devils): Those who descend from above do not easily tolerate those who crawl forth from the Abyss. (grants to special abilities)
  • @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-hindrances.Vow]{VOW} (Major — Protect humanity): The blessed must protect the flock that remains on the ravaged Earth. (grants to hindrances)

Faith.name: Faith
Faith.description: All celestials start with a d6 in Faith. This increases their maximum to d12+1

Humans.name: Humans
Humans.description:
Humans

Humans in most settings get one free @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01edges000000000]{Edge} of their choice. This option reflects their versatility and adaptability compared to most other ancestries.

For more variety, the GM might give humans abilities based on culture. For instance, a nomadic, horse-based society might start with skill points in Riding and Survival. Cultural templates are designed just like making new ancestries, though GMs should allow for more exceptions than usual since the abilities tend to be learned rather than truly innate.

  • ADAPTABLE: Humans begin play with any Novice @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01edges000000000]{Edge} of their choosing. They must meet its Requirements as usual. (grants to special abilities)

Dwarves.name: Dwarves
Dwarves.description:
Dwarves

Dwarves are short but stout, hardy people who come from massive caverns or high mountains. They are a proud, warlike people, usually made so by frequent contact with hostile creatures such as orcs and goblins.

Dwarves usually live upwards of 200 years. In most fantasy campaigns, they have ruddy skin and all human hair colors.

  • LOW LIGHT VISION: Dwarven eyes are accustomed to the dark of the underearth. They ignore penalties for Dim and Dark @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03illumination00]{Illumination}. (grants to special ability)
  • REDUCED PACE: Dwarves have short legs compared to most. Decrease their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} by 1 and their running die one die type. (via active effect)
  • TOUGH: Dwarves are stout and tough. They start with a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Vigor} instead of a d4. This increases maximum Vigor to d12+1. (via active effect)

Reduced Pace.name: Reduced Pace
Reduced Pace.description: Dwarves have short legs compared to most. Decrease their @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Pace} by 1 and their running die one die type

Tough.name: Tough
Tough.description: Dwarves are stout and tough. They start with a d6 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01traits00000000]{Vigor} instead of a d4. This increases maximum Vigor to d12+1

Android.name: Android
Android.description:
Android

Androids are semi-organic beings created by advanced technology. The example here mimics humans in most ways and can generally pass for them when desired (and not examined by a physician). Their advanced neural network gives them artificial intelligence complete with individual personalities, quirks, and emotions just like any other sapient being.

The android version presented here is a generic model. To create more specialized androids, use the custom racial abilities starting in @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01makingraces000]{Making Races}.

  • PACIFIST (Major): Unless the android is designed for combat, most advanced soc­ieties require the instal­lation of “Asimov Circuits,” a concept based on science fiction writer Isaac Asimov’s “First Law of Robotics.” The artificial being may not injure a sapient being, or through action or inaction, allow such a being to be harmed. This gives them the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-hindrances.Pacifist]{Pacifist} Hindrance. (grants to hindrances)
  • CONSTRUCT: Androids add +2 to recover from being @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Shaken}, don’t breathe, ignore one level of @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03damageeffect00]{Wound} modifiers, and are immune to poison and disease. Constructs cannot heal naturally. @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03healing0000000]{Healing} one requires the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Repair]{Repair} skill, which takes one hour per current Wound level per attempt and is not limited to the @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03healing0000000]{"Golden Hour"}. (grants to special abilities)
  • OUTSIDER (Major): Androids subtract 2 from @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Persuasion]{Persuasion} rolls when interacting with anyone besides other androids, and have no legal rights in most areas (they’re generally considered property). (grants to hindrances)
  • VOW (Major): Constructs are designed with a particular purpose. Player character constructs have broad directives such as serving a particular corporation or political faction. This acts as a @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-hindrances.Vow]{Major Vow} to that particular directive. If this ever causes a conflict of interest, the player and GM must figure out what the construct’s programming requires. (grants to hindrances)

Saurians.name: Saurians
Saurians.description:
Saurians

Lizard men typically come from steaming jungles or deep deserts where they have unique civilizations unknown to other sentient beings.

  • ARMOR +2: Saurians have scaly skin that acts as leather @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02armor000000000]{armor}. (grants to special abilities)
  • BITE: A saurian’s fangs are @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03naturalweapo00]{Natural Weapons} that cause Strength+d4 damage. (grants to weapons)
  • ENVIRONMENTAL WEAKNESS: Though not truly cold-blooded, saurians are poorly suited for frigid conditions. They suffer a −4 penalty to resist @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor04theadv.JournalEntryPage.04cold0000000000]{cold} environmental effects, and suffer +4 damage from cold-based attacks. (grants to special abilities)
  • KEEN SENSES: Saurians have acute senses, giving them the @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-edges.Alertness]{Alertness} Edge. (grants to edges)
  • OUTSIDER (Minor): Most species distrust saurians for some reason. Perhaps it is their strange ways and customs, their often-sibilant speech, or an ancient subconscious fear of their reptilian ancestors. Saurians subtract 2 from @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Persuasion]{Persuasion} rolls with all but others of their kind. (grants to hindrances)
